name: Wilhelm Brandt
want: a good farm in the Willamette valley for his wife and four children
secret: He bought his wagon and oxen on credit from a St. Joseph moneylender under a false name, and a man may be riding after him.
voice: German-accented English, formal, apologises too much.
description: A German farmer whose Missouri farm was burned twice in the border war. He is the hardest worker in the company and the first to argue about the order of march.
appearance: Sunburnt, square-built, a good black coat kept for Sundays.
